meta.title: Alerts
meta.description: Alerts for price, change, news and earnings of your stocks, with the evaluation engine status and Telegram delivery.

dialog.description: Set up alerts to receive real-time notifications about changes in your stocks.

form.thresholdNote: The alert stores the threshold without a currency: the engine compares it with the last close of the security in its exchange currency.

errors.invalidSymbol: Enter a valid symbol (letters, numbers, dot or dash; maximum 20)
errors.ambiguousNumber: Ambiguous number format: use the dot for decimals and the comma for thousands (e.g. 1,234.56).
errors.pricePositive: The price must be greater than 0
errors.duplicate: You already have this alert set up.

telegram.configured: Telegram channel configured on the server
telegram.notConfigured: Telegram not configured: alerts only arrive in the app

list.thresholdNote: Each price threshold is compared with the last saved close of the security, without currency conversion; the rule does not store the currency, which is why it is shown without a symbol.

confirm.title: Delete alert
confirm.description: Delete {label}? This action cannot be undone.

push.title: Notifications on this device
push.iosPre: On iPhone or iPad notifications only work with the app installed (iOS 16.4 or later): in Safari tap
push.iosPost: , then reopen this page from the icon.
push.unsupported: This browser does not support push notifications. Telegram and email notifications keep working.
push.serverOff: Push notifications are not enabled on the server yet.
push.denied: You blocked GerarAI notifications. To enable them, allow them in the browser or system settings.
push.intro: Receive notifications even when the app is not open. You choose which types; the notice includes the source and the time.
push.errorEnable: Could not enable on this device. Try again.
push.errorSave: Could not save the change. Try again.

types.macroEvent: Macro events (CPI, jobs, FOMC): 24 h and 1 h before
types.earnings: Upcoming portfolio and watchlist earnings: 7 days, 1 day and same day

card.summaryDailyDigest: Daily portfolio digest; open the details to see data coverage.
